snippet.title: The First Descendant│Meet Nell | Character Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Meet Nell on August 7—a former Albion Executive Officer who has now risen as a full-fledged Descendant!
Harness her telekinetic powers and gunplay to dominate the battlefield!
PLAY FOR FREE: https://tfd.nexon.com/
 
The First Descendant is a next generation third-person co-op action RPG shooter (looter shooter) featuring high-quality graphics developed using Unreal Engine 5. It presents fun strategic boss fights through multiplayer co-op, various unique characters, exciting gunplay, and looting.
